reason: The linux_riscv64_ CI job fails with a conda solver error for the missing package `chrpath` on linux-riscv64. All other platforms (linux_64, linux_aarch64, linux_ppc64le, win_64, osx_64, osx_arm64) pass. A maintainer comment already notes a dependency on a chrpath-feedstock PR. There is no code or build bug in this feedstock — the blocker is upstream.
